decision_summary: Approve the narrow three-entity Policy Counterfactual Replay design for implementation.
rationale: Visionary confirms roadmap value, Builder reuses the existing calibration-report and route-policy model, and Guardian requires identical evidence, immutable baseline authority, hypothetical impact labeling, governance, and no optimization or automatic policy action.
recommendation: Implement schema, verifier, example, fixtures, documentation, roadmap, and release evidence, then run full self-review and Council review.
